output_dir.description: Directory where extracted facial images and data files are dumped.

passport_number.description: Passport number for Basic Access Control (BAC). Max 9 ASCII letters or digits.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth for BAC key derivation. Format YYMMDD.

expiration_date.description: Expiration date for BAC key derivation. Format YYMMDD.

mrz.description: Full Machine-readable zone (MRZ) string. If provided, overrides passport_number, date_of_birth, and expiration_date.

data_groups.description: List of Data Groups (DG1-DG16, CA, SOD, COM) to read from the chip. DG1 is MRZ, DG2 is Facial Image.
